tagline: Everyone in a story wants something. The good ones want the wrong thing first.

epigraph.text: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me: I am a free human being with an independent will.

art.note: The council chose a rigid 1:1.618 structure with the mask as negative space, preserving ragged iron-gall pressure in a single 4-second settle.

writers.note: Iron-gall mask: a 1:1.618 settle that lets the face breathe before the want cracks.

nuggets.hook: A cup cracks at the exact moment it becomes honest.
nuggets.body: Want is not the same as need; the crack is where the character stops performing.

nuggets.hook: A flat face can be a door if it refuses to turn.
nuggets.body: Roundness isn't realism; it's the reader's invitation to follow a choice.

nuggets.hook: Tell the wound once, then show the hand that hides it.
nuggets.body: Voice leaves fingerprints: diction, rhythm, and what the character won't say.

nuggets.hook: Every mask is a costume, but one is the face underneath.
nuggets.body: Name the mask first, then ask what it protects; the trickster, the monster, and the saint all borrow it.
